items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 109:1
items.html: Before the separation there is in ZA MAH and BAN, for in the smallness there is in him VAK of MAH and VAK of BAN; and in the Gadlut there is in him, from the chest and above, the GAR of MAH and BAN, and from the chest and below there is in him VAK of MAH and BAN. And ZA himself is discerned as MAH, and the aspect of his left side, namely the Nukva in his own body, which is the Malchut of his nine Sefirot, is called BAN, as is known. But after the separation, the whole side of BAN in him is sawed apart from him, namely the aspect of the Nukva in his body, and is given to the Nukva Rachel; then ZA remains entirely Hesed, which is MAH, and the Nukva is entirely Din, which is BAN.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 109:2
items.html: (To the question) And although, even after the separation, there is in him the aspect of the crown of Gevura, which is Din — and moreover, it is the aspect of a harsh Din, namely from the aspect of the first restriction, called the root of Din — nevertheless it does not serve in him for his own need, but in order to illuminate the Mochin in the Nukva Rachel. And this resembles the aspect of Aba and Ima and YESHSUT: even in the Mochin of AB, which is Hochma, Aba and Ima are discerned as the final MEM of Tzelem and concealed Hassadim, and the aspect of the Hochma they bestow to YESHSUT, who are the LAMED of Tzelem, and the aspect of revealed Hassadim. And yet Aba and Ima are called Hochma, even though they are concealed Hassadim, because they are the root of Hochma, except that they do not need the Hochma for their own need, but to bestow to YESHSUT, who need it. And in this manner here, in ZON: truly, the root of the Gevura and of the Mochin is only in ZA; nevertheless, he is discerned in the aspect of the final MEM of Tzelem, which is entirely concealed Hassadim, in the secret of the pure ring; therefore he does not use the Mochin for his own need, but to bestow to the Nukva, for only she needs the illumination of Hochma, being the aspect of revealed Hassadim. (Item 132).
